name: Default
desc: Placeholder catch-all set assigned automatically at import. Not a real product type — every product here still needs classification. Pick the set that matches what the product actually is.

name: Furniture
desc: Physical furniture pieces: sofas, chairs, tables, shelving. Pick when the product is a standalone furniture item sold as-is. Carries material, craftsmanship and weight attributes.

name: Bundle
desc: Multi-product bundles sold as one SKU (e.g. a table with chairs). Pick only for products composed of other catalogue products; carries bundle min/max limits.

name: Custom
desc: Made-to-order furniture configured per customer request. Pick when the product is built to the buyer's specification rather than stocked.

name: Premium Collection
desc: High-end limited furniture from the premium line. Pick only for flagship products marketed as premium; same physical attributes as furniture.
